programme.title: E23 - Pierre Feuillatre/Plastic/Haute-Bretagne Botanical Park

programme.title: E18 - Musee Des Douanes/Arnaud Faye/Glenn Martens/Bettenfeld-Rosenblum
programme.desc: In Bordeaux, the Musee des Douanes shines a spotlight on one of France's oldest institutions. Interview with Arnaud Faye, head of the Bristol restaurants. For the Diesel show, Glenn Martens transformed the catwalk into a graffiti area. Sheathing and gilding: the Bettenfeld-Rosenblum workshop has been working with leather since 1895.

programme.title: E8 - Germanier
programme.desc: For his spring-summer 2024-2025 show, 'Les Venimeuses' (The Poisonous), we meet Kevin Germanier, who represents a totally new generation of couture designers. His watchword: recycling!

programme.title: E4 - Dear Old Bangers/Lewis, The Wind-Swept Island
programme.desc: A profile of Rene Chollet, a classic car restorer. A journey of discovery to the Isle of Lewis, in the north of Scotland, swept by the harsh winds from the open sea. A harsh natural environment that has shaped the lives of the few inhabitants for centuries.

programme.title: E29 - Along The Seine
programme.desc: The Seine is mainly known through Paris, which nevertheless represents only 13 km of its total length of 775 km. Meet the people who shape today's Seine and bear witness to its past. programme.title: Is China Shaping Africa's Mobility Future?
programme.desc: A look at Uganda, where Chinese tech is transforming transport with electric buses, motorbikes and three-wheelers. Plus: An autonomous tractor aids farmers in India, and Austria bests the rest of Europe at night trains.

programme.title: Young Startups - Germany's Next Tech Champions?
programme.desc: Could Germany become a hotspot for the global markets of the future? Young startup founders are using cutting-edge innovations to tackle tomorrow's biggest challenges. They're not just dreaming about the future - they're building it.

programme.title: Cultural Beliefs Around Weight Loss And Weight Gain - Kopano
programme.desc: What does 'healthy” really mean in 2025? In this episode of Don't Hold Back, host Nozibele Qamngana-Mayaba sits down with fitness coach Kopano Mokhele, who deliberately gained 25 kilos and is now losing it again so that he can understand what his clients go through. Together, they unpack the myths and realities of health in an age of body image pressure and quick-fix diets.

programme.title: E2
programme.desc: 主角大森一平（香取慎吾）是人生被逼到懸崖邊的前播報員，被家人和孩子討壓的最爛男人，為了選舉，和單親爸爸的妹夫及其孩子們一起生活。在面對日常生活中的家庭和社會問題的過程中，最差勁的男人一邊和妹夫和孩子們一點一點地建立起真正的家庭關係，一邊希望逐漸建立更好的社會，不久後努力參加選舉……

programme.title: E8
programme.desc: 講述在司法不公不義的社會中，地下秘密的士公司「彩虹運輸」存在著一位特殊部隊出身的代表的士司機替一群無法受到法律保護的被害者們找回公理。

programme.title: E2
programme.desc: 故事改編自真人真事，講述福井縣高中生忽發奇想，希望航天員可在太空站吃到鯖魚罐頭，於是研發「宇宙食品」，更獲宇宙航空研究開發機構（JAXA）認證，並成功送上國際太空站（ISS）的勵志過程。

programme.title: E6
programme.desc: 日本現任首相武藤泰山原本打算退出政壇，結果再次發生「變身」意外，但今次交換的對象並非他的兒子，而是與普通國民交換身體，離奇的故事就此展開…！

programme.title: You Shoot, I Shoot
programme.desc: Hong Kong is an over-crowded city, where people are easily provoked with confilcts. Hitman BART and assistant director CHUEN offer a bargain package 'YOU SHOOT, I SHOOT'.

programme.title: Funny Ghost
programme.desc: Taxi dancer Yue puts herself head over heels in debt because of gambling. She tries to borrow a loan from her close friend, Ngor, with tricks of suicide. She pretendedly pushes Ngor down a tall building but falls from the rooftop herself. She has got a narrow escape and a windfall of picking up a sack of money from a Chinese spiritualized vase which belongs to a big brother, Hung. With the help of the spirit, Yue and Ngor win so much that they almost lose their sense. They want to keep the vase themselves so they must get away from the pursuit of a killer sent by Hung, as well as another two mysterious detectives...

programme.title: Lee Rock 1
programme.desc: Andy Lau leads a star-studded cast in this chronicle of one young officer's rise to power within the Hong Kong police force in the 1950s.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In China
programme.desc: Set in 1875, China. Wong Fei Hung and his disciples take on the unscrupulous dealers who are trying to entice gullible Chinese into slavery in America.

programme.title: Magic Cop
programme.desc: Lam, an experienced policeman, had his quiet and beautiful life in Tung Ping Chau. He often tackled criminal cases with his supernatural power. One day, the old lady living next door came to ask him to go Hong Kong Island to get back the dead body of her daughter, a stewardess who was killed by the police as being suspected to be a drug smuggler. Lam's niece, Lin, a young country girl, was very interested in the life of Hong Kong and decided to go with Lam. At the Police Station, Lam knew that the 'Stewardess' was killed by 2 police sergeants, Yin and Miu, after a desperate struggle. Lam explained that the 'Stewardess' had actually been killed before she came back to Hong Kong. She had been turned to be a living corpse and controlled by a Japanese magician for smuggling...

programme.title: Curry & Pepper
programme.desc: Two cops--both best friends and partners--both become the subject of a beautiful news reporter's documentary. The two soon find themselves competing for screen time as well as the love of the reporter while after a murderous arms dealer.

programme.desc: When Charlotte's invention for The Gizmo Show is accidentally destroyed and then rebuilt, Charlotte worries that the attention she gets could expose Kid Danger and Captain Man’s secret identity.

programme.title: E401 - iDate Sam & Freddie
programme.desc: Carly steps in to resolve an argument for Sam and Freddie. Soon Freddie and Sam are coming to Carly for help with every single fight. Now that she’s involved, how can Carly remove herself?

programme.title: E2 - The Grass is Greener
programme.desc: Go on a junk-food-fuelled urban holiday with the Street Troop, then watch the Hill Troop’s invasion of their turf turn sour. Monitor the Sisterhood’s plot to kidnap Sara’s baby before newly minted alpha Loci discovers his old rival is back in town.

programme.title: Osprey: Sea Raptor
programme.desc: Wade into a saltwater marsh along the Connecticut River to witness the heartwarming reunion of two ospreys who’ve been mates for a decade. Witness their highs and lows over a single summer as they raise their chicks and dodge a host of predators.

programme.title: E2 - Home Away from Home
programme.desc: Swim upriver with the Bay Family, where Anna offers a hand raising her grandpups before heading home to find interlopers on her turf. Watch a flood in the mangroves nearly sweep away a baby, and see the Townies eat clean through their resources.

programme.title: E6 - Queen of the Bay
programme.desc: Chase Anna to the Townies’ lair, where Mia and her newborn pups are hiding out. See the babies’ first swimming lessons before the clan moves to new digs, and welcome an era of otter peace as the Mangrove Family becomes a park’s main attraction.

programme.title: E7 - Colors & Patterns
programme.desc: Get a front-row seat to nature’s most spectacular fashion show. Admire the luxuriant blond manes of golden snub-nose monkeys, stunning pink flamingo feathers brought on by an all-crustacean diet, and the meaningful markings of gemsboks and cheetahs.

programme.title: E6 - Reptile Romance
programme.desc: Kick back as Mick and Adele break up a pair of mating eastern brown snakes at a retirement home. Take care of unwanted inventory with Stu and Liv, who capture a green tree snake in a warehouse, then sneak up on a killer visitor with Jess and Dan.

programme.title: After the Wildfires
programme.desc: Examine fire’s pivotal role in shaping Australia’s natural world. Tour the devastation left by 2020’s brutal bush-fire season, learn how climate change fuelled this watershed event, and chart the long-term recovery of the continent’s wildlife.

programme.title: E1 - Waterhole
programme.desc: Witness clashes over precious resources when the dry season brings a band of gladiators to an African savannah watering hole. See a lion-elephant territory brawl, an ant raid on a termite mound, and a honey badger’s risky dance with a deadly snake.

programme.title: E2 - Wild Coast
programme.desc: Go up against Australia’s wiliest gladiators and their impressive arsenals. Learn if these weapons, such as the kangaroo’s deadly boxing moves and the redback spider’s precision-engineered traps, can help them survive the ravages of climate change.

programme.title: E6 - Migration
programme.desc: Epic flights, adventurous sea journeys and exhausting road trips all play a key part in the lives of many species. These empires travel in search of food, shelter or a mate. But booking and organizing travel is no easy feat when those plans involve hundreds – even thousands – of individuals.

programme.title: E3 - Clash of the Alphas
programme.desc: Stand back when a brawl erupts after the Street Troop finds the Hill Troop on their turf. Assess Matnoor’s poor parenting skills, see alpha wannabe Ajit make his move, then cool off as a heat wave pushes everyone to share the wealth in the forest.

programme.title: E2
programme.desc: 俞笑擁有一段令人外人羨慕的婚姻，然而因一起女高中生的遇害案，警察宋誠發現俞笑成了其與手頭一樁塵封舊案的共同證人，調查過程中，警方發現俞笑丈夫朱鶴好好男人的外表下，藏著無數與案件相關的線索。而對於俞笑而言，遇見宋誠和身份成謎的安妮後，她開始直面多年前的陰影……
